steps.title: Check Docker Setup
steps.description: First, let's make sure Docker is ready to use in your environment.
tasks: Run `docker --version` to see if Docker is installed
Run `docker info` to check Docker status

steps.title: Pull and Run Your First Container
steps.description: Download a pre-made lightweight Alpine Linux image and run a quick command inside it.
tasks: Run a container that prints a greeting: `docker run alpine echo 'Hello from Docker!'`
List all containers (even stopped ones): `docker ps -a`

verification.command: docker ps -a | grep alpine && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Run a Background Web Server
steps.description: Launch an Nginx web server container running in the background (detached mode) and map port 8080 on your host to port 80 in the container.
tasks: Run Nginx in detached mode: `docker run -d --name my-webserver -p 8080:80 nginx`
Test the web server response: `curl localhost:8080`

verification.command: docker ps | grep my-webserver && echo PASS || echo FAIL

steps.title: Inspect and Clean Up
steps.description: View logs from your web server and safely stop and remove the container.
tasks: Remove the stopped container: `docker rm my-webserver`

verification.command: docker ps -a | grep my-webserver && echo FAIL || echo PASS
